title: Hellenise it.
html_source:
To “Hellenise” something would be an implication to sensually-aesthetically liberate.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: To “hellenise” basically means “to make more Greek” or “to adopt Greek customs”.

So I guess that would involve a certain liberation along aesthetic and sensual lines, but the way this is phrased is strange and confusing. I don’t think even Joyce used polypolysyllabic compound adverbs.
